results.content:
# UKHotViews

###### Friday 14 August 2026

# Mindgard raises £22m Series A as AI security funding matures

London and Boston-based MindgardMindgard has raised $30m (£22m) in Series A funding led by Album VC, with participation from existing backers including .406 Ventures and IQ Capital. The round is a substantial step up from previous raises (see - Mindgard raises further $8m for AI security testing), and comes roughly two years after the company was spun out of Lancaster University with £3m in seed funding (see - Mindgard raises £3m for securing AI models).

Mindgard [...] The new funding is earmarked for scaling product, engineering, sales and marketing, with deployment already underway across Fortune 2000 organisations spanning financial services, pharmaceuticals, gaming, digital services, semiconductors and healthcare, according to the company. That breadth is notable at the Series A stage, but Mindgard is entering a market for AI security that is already very crowded. There are a number of other AI-native specialists targeting this emerging segment, such as Adversa AI, which occupies an adjacent but narrower slice of the same problem, focused on model stress-testing and universal guardrails rather than the broader enterprise risk discovery, SOC integration and agentic system security Mindgard is building toward. [...] Mindgard

The proposition has stayed consistent since the firms seed stage, offering continuous red teaming and threat assessment aimed at the attack surface created by AI models, agents and applications, an area traditional application security tools were never designed to cover. Several years after the firm’s inception, Mindgard can now point to a public track record of more than 150 disclosed vulnerabilities, including a zero-day code execution flaw in Cursor IDE, a trusted workspace issue in Google Antigravity, and guardrail failures in ChatGPT's image generation.

# Mindgard Raises $30 Million to Protect AI Systems

The cybersecurity startup will use the fresh investment to scale its product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams.

By

Ionut Arghire

|

 + Flipboard + Reddit + Whatsapp + Whatsapp + Email

Funding

AI security startup Mindgard today announced raising $30 million in a Series A funding round that brings the total raised by the company close to $42 million.

The investment round was led by Album VC, with additional support from Karma Ventures and previous investors .406 Ventures, Atlantic Bridge, IQ Capital, and Lakestar. [...] Advertisement. Scroll to continue reading.

Mindgard will use the fresh funding to scale its product, engineering, sales, and marketing teams. The investment will help accelerate deployments across financial services, digital services, gaming, healthcare, pharmaceutical, and semiconductor sectors.

“AI is creating an entirely new attack surface and organizations need a fundamentally different approach to securing it,” said Mindgard CEO James Brear.

“We don’t just automate attacks. We operationalize expertise, turning the knowledge of leading AI security researchers and offensive security practitioners into the capabilities every enterprise needs to secure their AI,” Brear added.

Mindgard Raises $30M Series A  

Mindgard Raises $30M Series A

Mindgard, a Boston- and London-based AI security startup, has raised $30 million in Series A funding to scale its platform for discovering, assessing, and defending against security vulnerabilities in AI models, agents, and applications.

## Investors [...] ## Investors

The funding round was led by Album VC, with participation from Karma Ventures and existing investors .406 Ventures, Atlantic Bridge, IQ Capital, and Lakestar.

## Mindgard Use of Funds

Mindgard plans to use the new capital to scale its product, engineering, sales, and marketing operations in order to meet significant customer demand.

## About Mindgard

Founded in 2022, Mindgard provides a platform that captures and exploits security vulnerabilities within AI models, agents, and applications to help enterprises mitigate risk. Its technology combines automated reconnaissance, offensive security expertise, AI red teaming, and defensive capabilities to identify vulnerabilities across AI models, agents, and applications.

# Mindgard Raises $8M to Safeguard AI with Industry-First AI Security Solution

Fergal Glynn

January 16, 2025

Updated:

December 18, 2024

In a significant milestone for AI security innovation, Mindgard is proud to announce its $8 million funding round led by .406 Ventures, alongside key strategic appointments of two industry leaders, Dave Ganly and Fergal Glynn. With this funding and expanded leadership, Mindgard is poised to transform the AI security landscape, addressing the critical risks associated with AI adoption.

## Mindgard Raises $8M to Safeguard AI with Industry-First AI Security Solution

### The funding will accelerate R&D and propel Mindgard’s expansion into the U.S.

‍ [...] ‍

Today we announced an $8 million funding round and the appointment of two industry leaders to the roles of Head of Product and VP of Marketing. The funding was led by .406 Ventures with participation from Atlantic Bridge, Willowtree Investments and existing investors IQ Capital and Lakestar. The new executives, Dave Ganly, a former Director of Product at Twilio, and Fergal Glynn, who most recently served as CMO at Next DLP (acquired by Fortinet), will play a critical role in the company’s product development and launch Mindgard’s expansion into the North American market with a leadership presence in Boston. [...] Mindgard is revolutionizing AI security testing and automated AI red teaming with its award-winning Dynamic Application Security Testing for AI (DAST-AI) solution. This cutting-edge technology identifies and resolves AI-specific vulnerabilities that can only be detected during runtime. For organizations adopting AI or establishing guardrails, continuous security testing is essential for gaining risk visibility across the AI lifecycle. Mindgard’s solution integrates into existing automation, empowering security teams, developers, AI red teamers and pentesters to secure AI without disrupting established workflows.
